answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying identity to verifiable work, not cheap accounts. A newcomer completes a small task, sealed as a quartz ledger entry that cannot be copied. A prism review splits it into independent checks by different established peers with no stake. Only if the checks agree may one peer extend a vine endorsement, each lineage sponsoring one newcomer per epoch. On fraud, the seal shatters, the endorsement is revoked, and the sponsor loses standing. Faking many identities needs real work and sponsors each time, making it costly, slow, and easy to spot.
